summary: The blocker is fixed. Both splice plates now have both M3 holes: out/parts/splice_l.stl and splice_r.stl have genus 2, and the render shows two holes plus the belly chamfer. I also checked every other exported STL by mapping each registered fastener site (report.json hole_walls) into print orientation using the bounding boxes in assembly.step. All 52 sites are open in the files that would be printed, and each part's genus fits its through-holes. The new holewall 'filled hole' check and its test pass (3/3). Moving the aft elevon rod 9 -> 8.7 mm gained only 0.03 mm of wall and cost 0.3 mm of web. The tube-epoxy note is better, but taping a tube that has to go back into a sleeve with almost no clearance will not work. Both are minors.

findings.issue: Measured by ray-casting from the rod axes (joiner proxies in out/assembly.step) at 1 mm steps along the 25 mm each half holds. Aft bore wall: elevon_lo/ro 1.09 mm at the split, tapering to 0.92 mm at the rod's outboard end, under 1.0 mm over the outer ~12 mm. At 9 mm it was 0.89-1.06, so the 0.3 mm move bought 0.03 mm. elevon_l/r: 1.05 mm. The web between the bores is now 1.10 mm (lo/ro) and 1.00 mm (l/r); it was 1.30-1.40 because the bore centres are now 4.1 mm apart, not 4.4. The front bore is unchanged at 1.26-1.36 mm. DESIGN.md still says '~1 mm wall each' and 'web ~1.3-1.4 mm', and the elevon.py docstring says '~1.3 mm of web'. Both are wrong now. The part will still print: a 0.92 mm wall is two perimeters, and the rod's load is small.
findings.fix: Chord position is not what limits this wall; the section thinning toward the tip is. Either shorten JOINER_L to 40 mm (the rod then ends where the wall is still about 0.97-1.0 mm), or put the aft rod's z centre midway between the skins over the outer half rather than at the split. Then correct the DESIGN.md and docstring numbers to what you measure (aft wall, and web about 1.0-1.1 mm).

findings.issue: The new note (wing_l1/r1 assembly_note, ASSEMBLY.md lines 66-74) has the right idea: the pod becomes the alignment jig, no epoxy reaches the pod, and you clean once after cure. But it says to wrap the pod-side length of each tube in tape and then slide it back into the pod sleeve. pod.py cuts that bore at od + 0.2 (0.1 mm radial), and FDM holes print about 0.1 mm small, so the tube is already a near-zero fit. One layer of packing tape (about 0.05 mm, more at the overlap) will jam the tube or get scraped off at the sleeve mouth. The note also does not say that the tube has to come out of the pod to be taped.
findings.fix: On the tube's pod-side length, use a zero-thickness release agent (paste wax or a thin film of petroleum jelly, wiped off after cure) in place of tape. Keep the tape strip on the pod's side face round the root. Add 'slide each tube out of the pod to treat its pod-side length, then refit it' so the order is clear.

findings.issue: Still open, tracked in their own PLAN item (not new): no TPU belly skid; consumables missing from the mass model (TWR 1.53 against 1.5); slender-part spacing on the plates; hatch tongue support, flush heads and side lip (8.3 % support); proud socket heads on the splice plates; no pushrod keep-out; the vtx_ant proxy starts at pod_top; the RX antenna is inside the pod; no VTX power cap; TE_MIN 1.0 (elevon walls 1.02-1.05 mm); URDF joint and link names collide; modifiers not written into the 3MF.
findings.fix: As listed in that PLAN item and the previous review.
